label: Nonreflexive giving from a self-edge bridge and an existing exclusion
meaning: A new conditional support alternative for strict non-self-GivesAt using the existing sourced no-efficient-self-cause node (8b2561cd) and one OPEN cross-sense self-edge bridge. The original Second Way noSelfCauseFromPriority theorem independently supplies that existing exclusion under its already recorded priority premises. The same efficient relation and F.esse appear in the two antecedents; no blanket equivalence with F.CausesIn or time priority is assumed. The new route preserves the direct-assumption option for no-efficient-self-cause as well as its priority derivation. Nothing proves the application truth of the cross-sense bridge, a causal source's possibility, or actual God-existence. The original priority-premise route in this module remains an alternative and now reuses this helper.
